farmers.title: File:Farmer manually harvesting rice in Raichur, Karnataka.jpg
farmers.author: Nanditha Gogate, WELL Labs
farmers.desc: A female farmer is using a sickle to harvest rice stalks in Raichur district of Karnataka, India. A combine harvester in the background is also doing the same. The farmer may be harvesting rice for domestic use.
